title: SpatialEval VQA test4635 schema / official scoring-semantics audit (CPU-only)
unique_conclusion: SCHEMA_AUDIT_PASS: the frozen SpatialEval VQA test4635 manifest and the official d82ba382 evaluator/inference semantics were re-verified CPU-only (SHA256, 4635 unique IDs, 2318+2317 parquet split, four tasks x question_id structure, three oracle fields, and the official per-task substring-containment scoring). The set may be frozen as an external confirmation set not used for Selector tuning. However, the official evaluation.py defines only per-task Acc = correct/line_count (no total-score formula in the artifact), compares str(oracle_answer).lower() as a substring of the parsed answer rather than by equality, evaluates only files named m-*_w_reason.jsonl, and has no spatialreal handler (an unassigned/stale model_answer is reused), so the task subset, score aggregation, and parser port must be explicitly frozen before any official confirmation claim. The existing evaluation/spatialeval_metric.py is a draft exact-match metric and must never be called an official reproduction.

inputs.note: Read for cross-check; summary declares row_count=4635, unique_id_count=4635, split=test, status=MANIFEST_BUILT_OFFLINE, and two source parquet row counts 2318+2317.

manifest_verification.frozen_record_sha256_chain_scheme: sha256 of concatenated record_sha256 values in file order

spatialmap.0: direction multiple-choice; oracle_answer is a compass direction
spatialmap.1: object-name/person-location multiple-choice; oracle_answer is a free-text entity
spatialmap.2: count from options; oracle_answer is an integer string

mazenav.0: right-turn count; oracle_answer is an integer string
mazenav.1: total-turn count; oracle_answer is an integer string
mazenav.2: binary Yes/No; option letter maps A=Yes (333), B=No (167); official evaluator treats qid==2 as binary

spatialgrid.0: block-count; oracle_answer is an integer string
spatialgrid.1: animal identification; oracle_answer is one of 5 animals
spatialgrid.2: animal identification; oracle_answer is one of 5 animals

spatialreal.0: real-image spatial QA; oracle_answer is free text or count-like; NOT handled by official evaluation.py

oracle_fields.official_normalization: lowercase via str(oracle_answer).lower(); no punctuation stripping on the reference side

option_format.binary_template: one option-letter line plus binary Yes/No mapping A=Yes, B=No

official_evaluator_semantics.comparison_direction: oracle_answer is the needle, parsed model answer is the haystack
official_evaluator_semantics.line_count_semantics: every JSONL output line increments line_count before parsing; ValueError-skipped records still count in the denominator
official_evaluator_semantics.total_score_notes: evaluation.py only emits a per-task CSV of accuracy per model; it contains no cross-task total. Any 'overall' number must be defined by the caller before pre-registration and cannot be described as the official total.

filename_contract.consequence: outputs not named m-*_w_reason.jsonl are silently skipped by main()

spatialreal_bug.description: For task == 'spatialreal' no branch assigns model_answer, so the local variable is unbound on the first row (NameError) or silently reuses the previous row's model_answer on later rows, producing stale-answer scoring.
spatialreal_bug.mitigation: freeze either a task subset excluding spatialreal, or a corrected/ported handler with focused tests, and record it in pre-registration

spatialmap: question_id 1: entity-name heuristics + brand-specific claude/geminiv/gpt4o patterns

known_substring_inflation.example_pattern: oracle_answer '0' contained in a parsed answer like '10' would score correct

official_evaluator_semantics.test_prompt_leakage: inference output stores the full 'prompt'; the evaluator only parses 'answer', but any frozen artifact must not leak reference labels into parsing

w_reason.effect: appends 'First, provide a concise answer in one sentence. Then, elaborate on the reasoning behind your answer in a detailed, step-by-step explanation.'
w_reason.evaluator_requirement: official evaluation.py only scores m-*_w_reason.jsonl, so w_reason=True is the path coupled to the shipped parser

official_inference_semantics.completion_flag: --completion appends 'Answer:' instead; not the path recognized by the shipped evaluator filename contract
official_inference_semantics.reason_parser_coupling: model-specific regexes for claude/geminiv/gpt4o extract short answers from reasoned outputs

per_model_actual_calls.bunny_hf: generate(max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens, use_cache=True) with no explicit do_sample/temperature/top_p -> greedy decoding; CLI temperature/top_p ignored
per_model_actual_calls.qwen_vl: model.chat(...) with no explicit generation kwargs -> model default sampling
per_model_actual_calls.instructblip: generate(do_sample=False, num_beams=5, max_new_tokens, top_p=0.9, repetition_penalty=1.5, length_penalty=1.0, temperature=1)
per_model_actual_calls.llava_or_merged_bunny: model.generate(prompt, image, args.temperature) -> sampling depends on wrapper

sampling_and_generation.conclusion: there is no single uniform official sampling config across model backends; generation parameters must be frozen per chosen backend

official_inference_semantics.question_grouping: inference groups dataset items by question_id and optionally caps with --first_k per question type
official_inference_semantics.device_default: cuda (device arg); this audit used none

existing_metric_disclaimer.reason: It performs answer-only exact match after a custom normalization; it does not implement the official model-specific heuristic parsers, the w_reason extraction branches, or the official substring-containment comparison.
existing_metric_disclaimer.rule: It must never be cited, labeled, or reported as an official SpatialEval reproduction or as the official evaluator.

label_materialization_and_blind_test.materialization: oracle_answer/oracle_option/oracle_full_answer were materialized from the official parquet by the offline manifest builder and are frozen in the manifest; this audit inspected them only in aggregate.
label_materialization_and_blind_test.interpretation: Because labels have been materialized and inspected, this is NOT a label-blind test. Because no three-arm predictions or scores have been produced or observed, it remains an external confirmation set not used for Selector tuning; it must not be reused for algorithm design or hyperparameter selection.
label_materialization_and_blind_test.draft_config_note: configs/2026-10-09-spatialeval-vqa-external-confirmation.draft.json still records labels_observed=false; after this audit that field should be updated to true in the pre-registered successor (the draft itself must not be edited by this audit).

findings.summary: All four fixed input SHA256 values match; manifest has 4635 lines, 4635 unique sample_id, and the summary's 2318+2317 parquet split with both parquet SHA256 values; all 4635 record_sha256 recompute under the compact sorted-key JSON scheme.

Four tasks: spatialmap 1500, mazenav 1500, spatialgrid 1500, spatialreal 135. question_id {0:1635, 1:1500, 2:1500}; mazenav qid2 is binary (A=Yes 333, B=No 167) with a single option-letter line, all other task/qid groups have 4 ordered A-D options.

Official evaluation.py compares str(oracle_answer).lower() by substring containment in the parsed answer (not equality), scores per-task Acc = correct/line_count with no total-score formula, and only reads m-*_w_reason.jsonl inputs. No spatialreal handler exists, so spatialreal rows silently reuse the previous row's model_answer (or raise NameError on the first row).

oracle_full_answer is exactly '<option>. <answer>' for all 4635 rows, but it is only an exact prompt line for 3466 rows; for 1169 rows it is a prefix of the actual option line (the option text contains the answer as a substring). Official scoring ignores oracle_option/oracle_full_answer and uses oracle_answer only.

Existing evaluation/spatialeval_metric.py is a draft exact-match metric, not the official parser, and must never be called an official reproduction; label fields were programmatically materialized and aggregated here with no three-arm predictions/scores observed, making this an external confirmation set not used for Selector tuning but not a label-blind test.

limitations: Image bytes are not stored in the manifest (image_storage=parquet_embedded_or_local); only image_sha256/width/height were audited. Any image-based re-materialization must re-pin the parquet SHA256.
Only the three provenance artifacts were read; the official repository's utils/format_filename, dataset loader, and any external overall-score aggregation were not available and could not be audited.
The spatialreal handler gap is a source-reading finding, not an executed failure, because no inference was run.
The license status remains NOT_EXPLICITLY_STATED; this audit does not resolve licensing or distribution rights.
No model, GPU, network, or inference was used; this report only validates schema and official scoring semantics.
